key_patterns: aws-cdk-lib 2.156 API: apigwv2.WebSocketApi(scope,id,{connectRouteOptions,disconnectRouteOptions,defaultRouteOptions}) creates built-in $connect/$disconnect/$default routes internally; wsApi.addRoute(routeKey, {integration}) returns a WebSocketRoute construct (has .node) for custom action routes. apigwv2.WebSocketStage(scope,id,{webSocketApi,stageName,autoDeploy:true}) synthesizes AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage with AutoDeploy=true. CloudFormation does NOT auto-create a dependency from the auto-deploying Stage to the Route resources, so the auto-deployment can precede the routes and serve an empty/partial route set -> $connect not deployed -> API Gateway drops the handshake -> client sees close code=1006 and the Lambda is never invoked. Tests use Template.fromStack + Match and assert on resource types/RouteKeys, never on generated logical IDs.
